logMd:
### Round 1 - Track T5 (npm ecosystem)

**Date:** 2026-08-26. **Platforms:** registry.npmjs.org search API, unpkg.com (package file listings), github.com repo pages, raw.githubusercontent.com (SKILL.md verification), one WebSearch. gh CLI avoided per instructions; api.github.com not needed.

**Queries (17):** registry keyword searches `keywords:agent-skill` (pages 1+2), `keywords:claude-skill`, `keywords:claude-code-skill`, `keywords:agent-skills`; text searches `claude skill design`, `agent skill accessibility`, `ux agent skill`, `design tokens skill`, `skill ux writing`, `figma skill agent`, `user research skill claude`, `design system skill claude`, `web design skill claude code`, `a11y skill wcag agent`, `prototype wireframe skill`; WebSearch `ui-ux-pro-max github mrgoonie skill` to resolve a repo.

**Method:** every design-relevant hit was opened at its repo (or, when repo was missing/dead, its published npm tarball via unpkg `?meta`) and SKILL.md existence checked; ~20 raw/unpkg SKILL.md confirmations. vercel-labs/skills CLI inspected per assignment; one-hop follow to vercel-labs/agent-skills yielded the web-design-guidelines skill and the skills.sh / agentskills.io leads.

**Candidates (32):** flagship ui-ux-pro-max (121k stars, 93k monthly downloads, npm license CC-BY-NC-4.0 vs repo MIT - flagged); orchestrated suites @mlllm/ui-ux-agent-skill-system (21 verified SKILL.md incl. ux-audit + design-critic + figma workflow skills), moodforge, design-playbook, ultimate-design, design-lagann; design QA/anti-slop: unslop-preflight, overhaul-ui, singulariti, design-details, memi; accessibility: arc-a11y-skills (10 skills, UNLICENSED - licensing risk), ultra11y (ACT-rules-validated), @ymrl/a11y-check-skills, @crstnmac/a11y-audit; design systems: Adobe Spectrum design-data-skill, dopod-design (Carbon), roast-my-design-system, press, ui-pro-forge; research/strategy: uxcraft (only npm skill with real UX research/IA/JTBD coverage); prototyping: wireloom (wireframe DSL), COVA make-design; design engineering: PixelPrint (Figma D2C, 9 skills), coherent; agentic-ui: @pro-vi/designer (drives claude.ai/design); platform guidance: apple-hig-skill.

**Rejections:** component libraries and a11y linters (not skills), Figma MCP servers, mega-catalogs (pm-claude-skills, claude-skills-library) as prompt-dump risk, dead links (fasiaa/design-skill-package - though the singulariti npm package itself verified via unpkg; h4shed/skill-ascii-mockup), renamed duplicate (vibe-design-md-architect -> unslop-preflight), skillui reclassified as a skill *generator* lead.

**Could not verify:** @superdesign/cli skill contents (repo 404/private); exact SKILL.md filename inside adobe spectrum-design-data tools/design-data-skill; design-playbook's exact SKILL.md path; apple-hig-skill and ui-pro-forge-cli SKILL.md contents (npm-only, no repo); designpaca repo (self-hosted git.chanpaca.net, not opened - npm metadata only); synthesisui agent manifest.

**Gaps observed:** npm has essentially zero skills for UX writing/content design (design-details' copy sub-skill is the only touch), user research/discovery interviews, usability testing, product analytics (design-details analytics sub-skill only), IA (only inside uxcraft), and design ethics/dark patterns. Round 2 should chase those on GitHub directly, plus the skills.sh / ui-skills.com / skillsllm.com directories, mrgoonie/claudekit-skills, and the ssheleg family.
